notes: First matching rule wins. Unknown trust levels only match rules that explicitly allow them. R4 is denied everywhere by default; standing rules can only be added by editing this file (which is read-only to the agent).

rules.comment: Read-only actions are safe from any channel.
Local reversible actions only from the local terminal.
Local hard-to-reverse actions require an explicit approval from the local terminal.
Anything externally visible is never silent; it asks from a confirmed channel.
Destructive or financial actions are denied by default. A standing rule must be added here by hand.
